scanNote:
PHOTO FILE - UNIT 12 (raqamsiz bet, pdf 155). Qirqib olinadigan karta. Yuqorida to'q sariq 'UNIT 12'.

⚠ Unit 10 va 11 uchun Photo File kartasi yo'q (kitobda shunday).

IKKI SURAT va bo'sh qatorlar (otkritka yozish uchun):
1-SURAT: palma daraxtlari, somon tomli bar, katta ko'k basseyn, oq mehmonxona binolari. Yozuv: 'hotel - Hawaii'. Chapda va ostida 20 ta bo'sh qator.
2-SURAT: qorli tog'lar, chang'ilar, chang'ichilar, yog'och uy (chalet). Yozuv: 'chalet - Switzerland'. O'ngda 15 ta bo'sh qator.

⚠ Bu 84-betdagi Writing (Project) uchun shablon: 'Use the pictures in the Photo File section to help you write two postcards. Write where you are and where you are staying, what the weather/food is like and your recommendation.'

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the two pictures. Where are they and what can you do there?
exercises.instructionUz: Ikki suratga qarang. Ular qayerda va u yerda nima qilish mumkin?
exercises.explanationUz:
SURATLAR:
  1 HOTEL - HAWAII: palma
    daraxtlari, katta basseyn, somon
    tomli bar, quyoshli havo
  2 CHALET - SWITZERLAND: qorli
    Alp tog'lari, chang'ichilar,
    yog'och uy


⚠ 'HAWAII':

  = Gavayi (AQSh, Tinch okeandagi
  orollar). /həˈwaɪi/.


⚠ 'A CHALET':

  = shale (tog'dagi yog'och uy).
  /ˈʃæleɪ/ - 't' o'qilmaydi.


⚠ 'A PALM TREE':

  = palma daraxti.

items.en: Picture 1: Where is it? What is the weather like? What can you do there?
items.uz: 1-surat: Bu qayer? Ob-havo qanday? U yerda nima qilish mumkin?
items.answerEn: It's a hotel in Hawaii. The weather is sunny and hot. You can swim in the big pool, relax under the palm trees and have a drink at the bar.
items.answerUz: Bu Gavayidagi mehmonxona. Ob-havo quyoshli va issiq. Katta basseynda suzish, palma daraxtlari ostida dam olish va barda ichimlik ichish mumkin.

items.en: Picture 2: Where is it? What is the weather like? What can you do there?
items.uz: 2-surat: Bu qayer? Ob-havo qanday? U yerda nima qilish mumkin?
items.answerEn: It's a chalet in Switzerland, in the mountains. The weather is snowy and cold. You can go skiing and enjoy the beautiful mountain scenery.
items.answerUz: Bu Shveytsariya tog'laridagi shale. Ob-havo qorli va sovuq. Chang'i uchish va go'zal tog' manzarasidan bahramand bo'lish mumkin.

exercises.instructionEn: Use the pictures to write two postcards (Unit 12, Writing Project, p. 84). Write where you are and where you are staying, what the weather/food is like and your recommendation. Use the postcards in Ex. 10 on p. 84 as models.
exercises.instructionUz: Suratlardan foydalanib ikki otkritka yozing (12-unit, Yozuv loyihasi, 84-bet). Qayerdaligingiz va qayerda turganingiz, ob-havo/ovqat qanday ekani va tavsiyangizni yozing. 84-betdagi 10-mashq otkritkalaridan namuna sifatida foydalaning.
exercises.explanationUz:
OTKRITKA QOLIPI (84-bet):
  Dear ...,
  We're having a [sifat] time/
  holiday here in [joy].
  We're staying in/at [joy].
  The weather is [sifat] and the
  food is [sifat].
  You must visit ... / It's
  definitely worth a visit!
  Love, / Best wishes, + ism


1-OTKRITKA: HOTEL - HAWAII
  quyoshli, issiq; basseyn, plyaj;
  dengiz mahsulotlari, mevalar

2-OTKRITKA: CHALET - SWITZERLAND
  qorli, muzday sovuq; chang'i;
  fondyu, issiq shokolad


⚠ 'FONDUE':

  = fondyu (eritilgan pishloq
  taomi - Shveytsariya).
exercises.bookRef: Coursebook, Photo File, Unit 12 (84-bet, Writing Project)

structure.modelEn: Dear Sam, We're having a wonderful holiday here in Hawaii. We're staying in a beautiful hotel with a huge swimming pool and palm trees everywhere. The weather is sunny and boiling hot, and the food is delicious - we eat fresh fish and tropical fruit every day. You must come here one day! Love, Emma
structure.modelUz: Aziz Sam, Biz bu yerda, Gavayida, go'zal ta'til o'tkazyapmiz. Biz ulkan basseynli va hamma yerda palma daraxtli chiroyli mehmonxonada turibmiz. Ob-havo quyoshli va qaynoq issiq, ovqat esa mazali - har kuni yangi baliq va tropik meva yeymiz. Bir kun bu yerga kelishing kerak! Muhabbat bilan, Emma
structure.noteUz: Qayerda, turar joy, ob-havo, ovqat, tavsiya.

structure.modelEn: Dear Tom, We're having a fantastic time here in the Swiss Alps. We're staying in a cosy wooden chalet near the ski slopes. The weather is snowy and freezing cold, but we go skiing every day. The food is great - the cheese fondue and hot chocolate are wonderful! It's definitely worth a visit. Best wishes, Mark
structure.modelUz: Aziz Tom, Biz bu yerda, Shveytsariya Alp tog'larida, ajoyib vaqt o'tkazyapmiz. Biz chang'i qiyaliklari yonidagi shinam yog'och shalede turibmiz. Ob-havo qorli va muzday sovuq, lekin har kuni chang'i uchamiz. Ovqat ajoyib - pishloq fondyusi va issiq shokolad go'zal! Bu albatta tashrifga arziydi. Eng yaxshi tilaklar bilan, Mark

modelAnswers:
Dear Sam,

We're having a wonderful holiday here in Hawaii. We're staying in a beautiful hotel with a huge swimming pool and palm trees everywhere. The weather is sunny and boiling hot, and the food is delicious - we eat fresh fish and tropical fruit every day. You must come here one day!

Love,
Emma

Dear Tom,

We're having a fantastic time here in the Swiss Alps. We're staying in a cosy wooden chalet near the ski slopes. The weather is snowy and freezing cold, but we go skiing every day. The food is great - the cheese fondue and hot chocolate are wonderful! It's definitely worth a visit.

Best wishes,
Mark
modelAnswersUz:
Aziz Sam,

Biz bu yerda, Gavayida, go'zal ta'til o'tkazyapmiz. Biz ulkan basseynli va hamma yerda palma daraxtli chiroyli mehmonxonada turibmiz. Ob-havo quyoshli va qaynoq issiq, ovqat esa mazali - har kuni yangi baliq va tropik meva yeymiz. Bir kun bu yerga kelishing kerak!

Muhabbat bilan,
Emma

Aziz Tom,

Biz bu yerda, Shveytsariya Alp tog'larida, ajoyib vaqt o'tkazyapmiz. Biz chang'i qiyaliklari yonidagi shinam yog'och shalede turibmiz. Ob-havo qorli va muzday sovuq, lekin har kuni chang'i uchamiz. Ovqat ajoyib - pishloq fondyusi va issiq shokolad go'zal! Bu albatta tashrifga arziydi.

Eng yaxshi tilaklar bilan,
Mark
